Asset: one transparent full-body 1024x1536 cat-girl production reference.

Far LEFT shoe slightly higher in the image due to ground depth, narrower and more side-on, attached consistently to its shin. Side-view body with a mildly elevated camera, no two identical flat shoe icons.
Single figure only, all ears hair tail hands shoes in frame. True transparent alpha, no background, glow, ground shadow, labels, diagram or extra parts. Match the original crisp detailed anime finish.
